name: Camping Steinplatte
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Steinplatte is situated in the municipality of Waidring in Tyrol's Kitzbühel district. It features pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents, complete with regularly cleaned modern sanitary facilities. The surrounding area boasts numerous hiking and cycling trails. In winter, the renowned Steinplatte ski area and prepared cross-country tracks are on the doorstep, making it ideal for a relaxing holiday in nature.
